# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and asynchronous readback** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces Graphite GPU bindings and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback. Built on Skia m152, this release adds Silk.NET Vulkan helpers and explicit font loading on Nano Server, while correcting source lifetimes and reducing text and data-copy overhead.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m152** — Updates the renderer to milestone 152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, preserving the allocator fallback used by SkiaSharp callers. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend** — Adds contexts, recorders, recordings and texture wrappers for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, including browser WebGPU. Graphite uses explicit record, snap, insert and submit operations; existing Ganesh APIs remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback** — Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface. Results are callback-scoped: copy data inside the callback to retain it, and handle a null result on failure. Ganesh completion requires submission and CheckAsyncWorkCompletion; Graphite surfaces use asynchronous rather than synchronous readback. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545), [#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration** — Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with typed backend-context and extension helpers, and makes the GRVkExtensions constructor public. The existing SharpVk package remains available; package production now includes the Silk.NET helper. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Keep borrowed native sources alive** — Region iterators retain their source region, and pixmap subsets and With* results retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing premature finalization while derived objects are still in use. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Deterministic resource cleanup** — Releases the previous uniform buffer on Reset, disposes copied stream assets when HarfBuzz blobs release them, and frees raster pixel storage when image creation fails. Native cached-data destruction now releases its mutex guard before deleting the owner. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))
- **Less copying and allocation** — Font.Shape avoids copying an existing feature array, tag formatting avoids boxed characters, and text marshalling and uniform lookup construction allocate less. SKData.SaveTo writes native spans directly on span-capable targets; .NET Framework and netstandard2.0 retain buffered copying. ([#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Bug Fixes

- **Do not read stale GPU textures** — Ganesh readbacks no longer return stale texture data when prerequisite render tasks fail to flush; additional font-rendering and Ganesh stability corrections are included. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## Platform

- **Explicit Nano Server font loading** — The Nano Server native build uses FreeType so fonts loaded from files, streams or data can render. It still has no system font manager: load a typeface explicitly rather than relying on the default font. Normal Windows builds retain DirectWrite. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Native debugging assets** — Produces separate Apple symbol packages with complete dSYM bundles for SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, without adding symbols to customer runtime packages. Android libraries retain matching build IDs and split-debug identities. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Font.Shape avoids a defensive feature-array copy, and Tag.ToString avoids character boxing. Apple symbol packages and deterministic Android debug identities improve native diagnostics; NuGet READMEs provide package-specific guidance.

## Release Candidate 1 (August 26, 2026)

Reduced shaping and tag-formatting overhead, corrected uniform-buffer and blob-stream cleanup, restored Silk.NET package production and added native debugging assets.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Introduced Skia m152, Graphite, asynchronous pixel readback and Silk.NET Vulkan helpers. Also enabled explicit Nano Server font loading and corrected region, pixmap and failed-image source lifetimes.
